cohort: Women who experienced stillbirth after 28 weeks of gestation in Al-Diwaniyah Maternity and Children Teaching Hospital, Iraq, between May 1, 2018 to April 30, 2019.
finding: The annual incidence rate of stillbirth was 9.8 per 1000 births, and principal risk factors included lack of regular antenatal care, poverty, maternal anemia, and pregnancy-induced hypertension.
